display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: (external) Collectible load context holding the generated assemblies. Unload only initiates unloading — the context is reclaimed once nothing references it, and collectible contexts never use ReadyToRun, so every method is JIT-compiled per context.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: Per-evaluation state, supplied by the caller on every invocation. A pooled invoker is shared, so each concurrent evaluation must bring its own context.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: Interface implemented by every generated CQL library class. Instances are process-wide singletons living inside the collectible assembly load context.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: A compiled CQL library: assembly bytes plus optional debug-symbol bytes. Record equality compares the byte arrays by reference, which is why the pool derives a content hash instead.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: Builder that accumulates AssemblyBinary instances (from files, directories or FHIR Library resources) and creates a LibrarySetInvoker from them. Short-lived: the ElmToolkit/CqlToolkit convenience paths construct a fresh one per call.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: Opt-in, consumer-owned pool that reuses LibrarySetInvoker instances across evaluations, keyed on assembly-binary content. Owns the lifetime of what it hands out: LRU eviction unloads the assembly load context and releases the invoker graph.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: Pool settings: Capacity (how many distinct library sets to keep loaded, a soft target) and MaxPendingUnloads (warn when this many evicted contexts remain unreclaimed).

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: Snapshot of pool activity: Hits, Misses, Entries and PendingUnloads. PendingUnloads is the leak signal — a climbing value means something is holding evicted library sets alive.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: (internal) Pool identity: a sorted SHA-256 hash over the assembly and debug-symbol bytes, plus the library set name and exception-continuation policy. Needed because AssemblyBinary's record equality is reference identity over its byte arrays.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: Owns one collectible AssemblyLoadContext and the invoker graph reflected out of it. Dispose unloads the context and releases the graph; when a pool owns the instance, Dispose is inert and the pool decides when to unload.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: One CQL library within the set, exposing its definitions. Holds a back-reference to its LibrarySetInvoker, so retaining one keeps the whole assembly load context alive.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
text-align:left; max-width:280px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;

span.div: One CQL definition, invoked through a delegate bound once to the generated library method. Also back-references its LibraryInvoker.
